notes: ὁ κύριος → 'his lord': no genitive pronoun stands to take the supplied possessive, so it is the article's own under rule 20's second arm.
τοῦ αἰῶνος τούτου leaves the article empty, the demonstrative occupying the determiner slot (rule 38), and the ASV's collocation 'this world' is followed rather than crossed (rule 25).
